name: Better Hotkeys
description: Keyboard shortcuts for common Chrome tab operations.

duplicate-tab.description: Duplicate the active tab or highlighted tabs

toggle-pin.description: Pin or unpin the active tab or highlighted tabs

move-previous.description: Move the active tab or highlighted tabs left

move-next.description: Move the active tab or highlighted tabs right

highlight-active.description: Toggle highlighting for the active tab

group-tabs.description: Group the active tab or highlighted tabs

new-window.description: Move the active tab or highlighted tabs to a new window

move-window-previous.description: Move the active tab or highlighted tabs to the previous window

move-window-next.description: Move the active tab or highlighted tabs to the next window
